summary: The diff implements all five requirements (REQ-16 through REQ-20) with good coverage. New pages for Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, and Export Certification are created; routing via @tanstack/react-router is set up; email addresses are updated in ContactSection and Footer; translations are added to the centralized file. A few minor gaps exist: the PrivacyPolicyPage and TermsAndConditionsPage contain hardcoded English strings not sourced from the translations file, and the layout wrapper behavior for sub-routes is unclear from the truncated diff.
